errors.name: InvalidAssets

fields.name: fee_vault
docs: USDC token account that receives fees and dust.

fields.name: assets
docs: Pyth Lazer ids from the pinned whitelist, 1 to 3, distinct.

fields.name: fill_secs
docs: Seconds until the room may start short-handed or be cancelled. 0 = default (10 min).

fields.name: interval_secs
docs: Seconds per interval (6 intervals per round). 0 = default (60 s).

fields.name: private
docs: Seal positions inside the TEE with owner-only permissions.

fields.name: side
docs: -1 short, 0 flat, 1 long.

fields.name: entry_ts
docs: When the current position was opened or last re-marked at a checkpoint.

fields.name: equity
docs: Equity at the last mark (private while the round runs).

fields.name: viewer
docs: The player's browser session key: a second permission member, so the app can read the
sealed position through the TEE without another wallet popup. Default = none.

fields.name: next_checkpoint
docs: Next checkpoint to process (1..=FINAL_CHECKPOINT).

fields.name: started_ts
docs: When start_room delegated the room.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Round clock origin (begin_round).

fields.name: elim_checkpoint
docs: 0 = alive; k = cut at checkpoint k.

fields.name: placement
docs: Final placement, 1 = winner. 0 = still alive.

fields.name: public_rank
docs: Rank among the alive at the last checkpoint (1 = leader). 0 = eliminated / not yet ranked.

fields.name: final_equity
docs: Equity at elimination or at the end. Never written while a player is alive.

fields.name: last_price
docs: Oracle prices used at the last checkpoint (public input, for the UI).

fields.name: finalist_count
docs: Number of finalists at the end (1..=3), seats in `finalist_seats` best-first.

fields.name: storm_kind
docs: One storm slot per interval (0..=CHECKPOINTS). Kind 0 = no storm.

fields.name: storms_requested
docs: Bitmask of intervals whose storm was requested / fulfilled.

fields.name: private
docs: TEE privacy on: begin_round requires every position to have an owner-only permission.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Bitmask of seats refunded on the cancel path.
